newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Levels well below normal.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Levels well below normal.

text.p: Ice levels were well below normal with only bays at the far northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia frozen above 65 degrees north, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Monday.

About five centimetres of fast ice had accumulated off the Finnish port of Kemi and off the port of Lulea in Sweden, it said in its bi-weekly report. There was some new ice off the Finnish port of Oulu.
The situation was almost unchanged from last week and an institute official told Reuters there were no obstacles to shipping.

Ports further south were still clear, with water temperatures ranging from one to six degrees Celsius in the Gulf of Bothnia and from four to six degrees in the Gulf of Finland, the institute said. (Temperatures of nearby isotherms, degrees Celsius)
